_comment: Stage B1 conditional freeze: second new instance perm4. AUTHORIZED conditionally by the user in chat on 2026-10-20 ('可以,a如果通过后你自动衔接上b1和b2,你做决定'): B1 may start ONLY IF Stage A's verdict is meaningful_positive. RR reuse is CERTIFIED (Stage A retrained RR on this host with a full manifest; embedding hashes are bound and re-verified at launch).
authorization_quote: 可以,a如果通过后你自动衔接上b1和b2,你做决定

trigger.also_requires: stage_a_determinism_assessment.json verdict == benign_nondeterminism (numerical-equivalence revision, user-approved option 2 on 2026-10-20, '选2吧'; supersedes the original bitwise_identical requirement; measured Stage A MAE drift 0.00087 m/s vs gate 0.005)

reuse.RR: certified reuse of Stage A retrained embeddings (hash-bound to stage_a_manifest.json, re-verified at preflight and at evaluation)

instance.name: perm4
instance.algorithm: identical family/algorithm as perm3 (global node permutation consuming the real region-size histogram in ascending region-id order)
instance.validation: outputs/perm4_generation.json checks all true (incl. differs from real/perm0/perm3)

RR.training: certified reuse of Stage A outputs (10 embeddings, hash-bound)

PP.training: retrain induced_exact + induced_clique_self on het_g8p0_perm4, seeds 0-4

PR.training: retrain induced_coeff_override (clique) on het_g8p0_perm4 with real coefficients, seeds 0-4

probe.readout: MAE of speed from the frozen ridge_a1 probe
probe.split: KFold(5, shuffle=True, random_state=0) over non-NaN speed labels

thresholds.interval: two-sided 95% t interval with 4 df over 5 paired seeds

stop_rules.meaningful_positive: replication on a second independent instance; combined with Stage A supports the A3 mechanism claim; B2 (new city) remains the external-validity step and requires data
stop_rules.meaningful_negative: direction reverses on the second instance; the effect is not instance-stable; stop independent topic, merge into A3
stop_rules.negligible: no practical content effect on the second instance; stop independent topic, merge into A3
stop_rules.inconclusive: stop; no additional seeds/instances to chase a result
stop_rules.run_failed: no retry; ledger and evidence preserved; user decides

claim_boundaries: Two instances on the same Porto network (perm3, perm4) are instance-level replication, not city-level external validity.
Certified RR reuse is bound to this host's Stage A chain; it does not certify the archived perm0 exploratory reuse.
Path decomposition remains path-dependent; RP not trained; no unique causal share claims.
